verdict.rationale: Sentry has a first-party docs page titled "Webhooks" under its Integration Platform, which points to a documented outbound webhook capability. The pack shows only that title, not how registration, event types or payloads work. Slack and PagerDuty notification integrations do not count toward this story. missing for 10: documented registration/subscription flow for webhook endpoints, list of subscribable event types, payload and signature verification details, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
